o1: Enables actin filament binding activity and microfilament motor activity; is a structural constituent of muscle. Predicted to enable myosin II motor activity and motor activity. Involved in egg-laying behavior; muscle contraction; skeletal muscle myosin thick filament assembly; ovulation; and myosin filament organization. Located in A band and striated muscle myosin thick filament. Part of muscle myosin complex. Is expressed in several structures, including body wall musculature; enteric muscle; germ line; intestinal cell; vulval muscle; and the myoepithelial sheath. Is part of striated muscle contraction. Predicted to interact with MYO-3. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in several diseases, including cardiomyopathy (multiple); congenital heart disease (multiple); contractures, pterygia, and spondylocarpotarsal fusion syndrome 1A; heart conduction disease (multiple); and muscle tissue disease (multiple). Orthologous to several human genes including MYH1 (myosin heavy chain 1); MYH13 (myosin heavy chain 13); and MYH15 (myosin heavy chain 15).
